During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]].

==The battle==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Lair of Grievous Date">{{TCWdates|110}}</ref> at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was stationed at [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]],<ref name="LoG">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point during the conflict, a battle was fought in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Green scout to Watcher base.''"<br />"''Copy, this is Watcher base, over.''"<br />"''Contact the fleet at Bestine. Inform them we've engaged Grievous and require reinforcements.''"<br />"''Right away, sir.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]], to [[Niner/Legends|Niner]] and [[Bel/Legends|Bel]]|audio=RequireReinforcements-LoG.flac|<ref name="LoG" />}}
[[File:Bel_Niner.png|thumb|right|265px|Niner and Bel being ordered by Commander Fil to contact the fleet at Bestine]]
The battle of the Bestine system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The battle was only illustrated on the Clone Wars map, which also referenced other elements from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet Bestine was mentioned in ''[[Lair of Grievous]]'', the tenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', which aired on [[December 12]], [[2008]].<ref name="LoG" />
